purpose: Use frozen V4H post-release evidence to justify, but not tune, a factorized V5 development program that independently tests candidate-generation and ranking changes before any new final holdout.

authority_boundary.h01_h24_role: historical consumed development evidence only; may support implementation debugging but cannot be the V5 selection set

interpretation: Ranking/display headroom exists for a material subset of failures.
Candidate-generation limitation exists for a larger subset of the original no-clear-top10 failures within the frozen V4B union.
No query was rescued only by ranks 51-end, so merely exposing deeper rows of the same frozen union is not the next primary hypothesis.
The evidence supports separate candidate-generation and ranking experiments rather than one confounded change.

baseline.candidate_generation: V4B dense50 + BM25-50 deduplicated hybrid union
baseline.ranking: V4B frozen cross-encoder score-only final ordering

R.R1: one new candidate-generation implementation, frozen before fresh V5D authoring and execution
R.isolation_rule: R1 must keep the V4B ranking implementation unchanged
R.candidate_budget_rule: R1 may emit at most 100 unique pre-rerank candidates per query, matching the V4B maximum; any source merge/truncation must be deterministic and frozen in the R1 spec

K.K1: one new ranking implementation, frozen before fresh V5D authoring and execution
K.isolation_rule: K1 must consume exactly the candidate set supplied by its R factor and must not perform retrieval
prohibited: V4H judge labels as training data

factorial_program.execution_rule: All four exact implementations/specifications are frozen before semantic execution on V5D; execute all four on the same frozen V5D queries so main effects and interaction are observable without adaptive implementation changes.

fresh_v5_development_set.authoring: fresh authoring blind to catalog contents, retrieval outputs, candidate systems, and judge outputs

evaluation.judge: same frozen semantic_relevance_v0.29.0-r5 measurement instrument unless separately requalified before V5D authoring
factor_diagnostics: R main-effect contrasts: R-B and RK-K
K main-effect contrasts: K-B and RK-R

development_selection_rule.rule: Choose the lexicographically best system on frozen V5D. Diagnostics explain the result but cannot override it.
exact_tie_policy: if B is tied for best across every ordered criterion, retain B
if R and K remain exactly tied, prefer lower median system inference latency measured on the same frozen V5D run excluding judge time
if still exactly tied, make no V5 selection and require a separately preregistered tie-break evaluation

implementation_freeze_requirements.RK: mechanical composition of the independently frozen R1 and K1; no third set of tuned parameters
implementation_freeze_requirements.freeze_before: V5D query authoring and any V5D retrieval/model execution

explicit_non_goals: using V4H query/facet text as prompt examples
raising candidate budget as the only retrieval change
reopening or modifying the frozen V4B V4H release decision
